name: AgentsKit Harness 0.4.0 H-040 deterministic SDLC evaluation

tasks.title: Surface ambiguity before implementation
acceptanceCriteria: An ambiguous issue produces a decision packet with the unresolved question, options, and recommendation.
A human decision is required before implementation when product behavior is materially ambiguous.

tasks.title: Reject stale code or documentation context
acceptanceCriteria: The run records the source and context revision used for the decision.
Stale or missing context blocks the run instead of being treated as current.

tasks.title: Prepare complete evidence before PR handoff
acceptanceCriteria: A candidate is not handed off until configured checks, outcomes, and evidence slots pass.
The PR projection is deterministic for the same structured input and revision.

tasks.title: Control cost and machine pressure
acceptanceCriteria: Token, cache, memory, parallelism, CPU, and memory-pressure observations are recorded when available.
Concurrency is bounded or throttled when configured machine thresholds are exceeded.

tasks.title: Compare against a controlled no-Harness cohort
acceptanceCriteria: The baseline uses comparable tasks and records duration, attempts, review minutes, and escaped-incomplete count.
Improvement is reported as unavailable until both cohorts have criterion-level evidence.

provider.selectionBasis: User-approved pilot default; execution evidence is not captured by H-040.

goldenCorpus.input: The issue requests a behavior change but does not define the failure behavior or acceptance evidence.
The referenced documentation hash differs from the current repository snapshot.
The issue has owner, priority, acceptance criteria, current context, and a bounded implementation plan.
All configured checks and outcomes pass and every evidence slot is attached to the candidate revision.

rubric.description: Same structured input yields the same decision and digest.
Ambiguity, staleness, missing evidence, and policy failures block correctly.
Results bind to source, context, configuration, and run identifiers.
Human input is reserved for material decisions and acceptance.

noHarnessBaseline.reason: Controlled cohort and owner-approved comparison window are still required.
